photos.label: Image 3 — portrait, collage tile 3
photos.caption: Some moments don’t need anything extraordinary to become special — just the right person beside you. Somehow, even the simplest days feel a little more beautiful when they’re shared with you. ❤️

photos.label: Image 1 — portrait, collage tile 1 (top-left)
photos.caption: This picture will always remind me of us in the beginning — of how silly I could be around you and how you somehow made even my dumbest little ideas feel worth doing. It’s one of those tiny moments that I’ll always look back at and smile, because it feels so perfectly us. ❤️

photos.label: Image 4 — portrait, collage tile 4
photos.caption: I still love the way you were looking at me in this moment, like everything around us had somehow disappeared for a second. Standing there with you near the falls, I remember thinking how lucky I was to have someone who could make even a beautiful place feel secondary. ❤️

photos.label: Image 2 — portrait, collage tile 2
photos.caption: That little bossy look is honestly one of my favorite things about you — like you’ve already decided how everything is going to happen, and I’m just here to follow orders. 😂❤️ Somehow, even when you’re being bossy, you still manage to look ridiculously cute.

photos.label: Image 5 — portrait, collage tile 5
photos.caption: Another little piece of our story that I’m quietly grateful we captured. I hope we look at this and remember not just how we looked, but exactly how happy we were standing there together. ❤️

photos.label: Image 6 — portrait, collage tile 6 (bottom-right)
photos.caption: Seeing you sleep like a little baby in this picture made me smile in a way I can’t really explain. For a moment, you didn’t feel like just the girl I love — you felt like my little baby, and I couldn’t help imagining our baby girl someday sleeping just like this. ❤️
